messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha@heliosai.com>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private Offer: HeliosAI GCP listing — proposal and invoice ask

Hi Rishi (and Karthik),

Thanks again for the demo last week. HeliosAI is ready to move forward with a GCP Private Offer but procurement has two asks that are outside Redwood's standard marketplace template: a temporary reduced rev-share for year one to help with onboarding economics, and a longer invoice term (net 90) for the pilot phase.

Summary:
- Rev-share: asking for 18% for year 1 (standard 25%) then revert to standard in year 2.
- Payment terms: net 90 for first 3 invoices, then standard net 30 thereafter.
- Commit: 12-month pilot, estimated $360k ARR if pilot converts.

Attached is our RFP (HeliosAI_RFP_v3.pdf) and a short procurement note. Can Redwood confirm whether you can do a one-time rev-share concession and net-90 for this customer? If this needs exec signoff we can supply a short business case and reference customer contacts.

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Director of Cloud Partnerships
HeliosAI

Samantha —

Appreciate the clarity here. Quick note for transparency: a year-1 rev-share move to 18% is a meaningful concession for marketplace economics; it will materially change our expected payout and channel reporting. Net-90 is also outside our standard for new customers.

Karthik — can you run the basic finance sensitivity and confirm the minimum acceptable rev-share we can offer for a 12-month pilot and whether net-90 can be done with prepayment milestones or an early-pay discount?

Im including a short deal summary and forecast I'm using to evaluate the ask.

Next steps I propose:
1) Karthik to provide quick P&L sensitivity (high level).
2) If numbers look acceptable, escalate to Marissa/Finance for exec signoff.
3) If approved, generate a DocuSign private offer and attach legal redlines.

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Private Offer: HeliosAI GCP listing — escalate for exec signoff

Team —

I ran the sensitivity against the forecast Rishi provided. High-level takeaways:
- If we do 18% rev-share year 1, expected marketplace take for Redwood vs. standard results in ~22% reduction in gross for year one on this install base. With projected conversion probability, it reduces our 12-month expected contribution by ~$46k.
- Net-90 increases DSO and introduces cash timing risk; finance would want a mitigating instrument (e.g., 1% early-pay discount or a 30% upfront milestone payment).
- Legal flagged that the customer is requesting a carveout on marketplace fees (they want credit for GCP credits) — we need a clean redline.

Suggested conditional package for exec signoff (to limit risk):
A) Approve rev-share = 20% for year 1, revert to standard thereafter.
B) Payment: Net45 standard, with option for net90 only if HeliosAI pays 30% at signing and remaining split across first two invoices. Provide 1% early-pay discount for payments within 15 days.
C) Require a 12-month minimum and an SLA milestone: if usage < 40% of forecast by month 6, Redwood can convert to standard rev-share immediately.

If Marissa/Finance signs off on this package, I will create the DocuSign and loop Legal for redlines.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Deal Desk, Marketplaces
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private Offer: HeliosAI GCP listing — rev-share proposal & invoice timing

Rishi / Karthik —

Thanks for the thorough analysis. Ive reviewed Karthiks suggested conditional package and approve the proposal with the following executive conditions:

1) Approve the negotiated package: rev-share 20% year 1, revert to standard in year 2.
2) Payment terms: Net45 default. Net90 allowed only if 30% upfront at signing + milestone schedule, and with 1% early-pay discount as proposed.
3) Legal must confirm the marketplace fee carveout language is approved and added to the DocuSign. No other carveouts.
4) Competitive alert: flag this customer in the CRM with the special terms and a 12-month review with RevOps.

Karthik — please prepare the DocuSign with the above terms and route to Legal for redlines. Kimberly — finance will coordinate the payment schedule and confirm accounting treatment; please reconcile how the net90 affects revenue recognition.

Conditional exec signoff granted — pending DocuSign and legal redline.

Marissa Cole
VP, Global Channel Sales
